title: Sensitivity, Performance, Robustness: Deconstructing the Effect of Sociodemographic Prompting
reasoning: The paper focuses on how sociodemographic factors (like gender, race, age, and education) influence large language model outputs in subjective tasks such as toxicity and stance detection. While toxicity is an ethical concern, the research is focused on human social identity and alignment rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, theological frameworks, or formal systems of ethics or morals.
